data.name: THE VERDICT
data.detailed_description:
Eight players. One Judge. And every decision could be your last.

In each round, the Judge calls two players forward and asks them the same question. If one player answers correctly while the other fails, the winner chooses which injury their opponent will receive. If both answer correctly, both players earn the right to choose an injury for each other.

But the round doesn’t end there.

After every question, all eight players take part in a random challenge. Nobody knows what comes next: a race, a test of strength, a fight, a precision challenge, or something else entirely.

Every injury affects a player’s abilities and can determine their fate.

Leg — reduces movement speed. In a running challenge, this disadvantage could become fatal.

Arm — reduces physical strength, making challenges involving force, fighting, or holding objects more difficult.

Eyes — damages vision, narrows the field of view, and creates visual interference, making precision challenges much harder.

Fingers — weakens grip strength and can become a decisive disadvantage in the final challenge.

And the most important part: you never know which challenge will come next.

You can cripple an opponent’s leg and hope the next challenge is a race. You can damage their eyes before a precision challenge. Or you can sacrifice an immediate advantage and cut off their fingers to prepare for the final.

Because everyone knows what awaits them at the end: a tug-of-war above a pit of spikes.

There are no safe choices. Every decision can give you an advantage — or bring you one step closer to death.

Answer correctly. Choose the injury. Adapt to the challenges. And do whatever it takes to be the last one standing.

data.short_description: Eight players. One Judge. Every choice could be your last. Outsmart opponents in trivia, inflict debilitating injuries, and endure random mini games. Outlast the competition to survive the deadly tug-of-war over a pit of spikes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11.0 compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770k or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11.0 compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains mature horror content, including violence, blood, injuries, death, disturbing imagery, frightening situations, and intense scenes of characters being attacked or killed.

Players may encounter corpses, environmental depictions of violence, threatening characters, and scenes intended to create psychological tension, fear, and distress.

The game does not contain sexual content or depictions of sexual violence.
